steps.title: Bem-vindo: Culture - Volume 2
steps.text: In this A1-level lesson, we'll explore essential vocabulary and phrases about "Culture". Get ready to level up your real-world communication skills!

words.example: The music festival happens every summer.
It's a tradition in my family to cook together on Sundays.
This holiday is celebrated with fireworks.

steps.title: Desafio de Tradução
steps.question: Qual é a tradução correta para "tradition"?

steps.title: Prática de Pronúncia
steps.text: Fale a seguinte frase em voz alta no microfone:

steps.question: Which sentence correctly demonstrates "Modal Verbs (can, could, must, should)"?

steps.title: Idiom: Piece of cake
steps.text: It means: "Something very easy to do.". Say the example sentence out loud:
steps.targetPhrase: The exam was a piece of cake.
